_about: Whiterun marks for side jobs (social/side_jobs.py). place = a TravelTo place name (dialogue/travel_places.json). owner = who the goods belong to or who pays; the game looks them up by name. risk: low | medium | high. wealth: 1 (modest) .. 3 (rich). Adults only.

theft.loot: rings, necklaces and gems on the shelves behind the counter
theft.note: he sells anything and watches the door more than his shelves; easiest while someone keeps him haggling

theft.loot: the dearer potions and rare ingredients on her shelves
theft.note: she gets lost in her mixing; a customer with questions keeps her eyes off the shelves

theft.loot: finely made daggers and jewellery-grade ingots inside Warmaiden's
theft.note: Ulfberth minds the shop while Adrianne works the forge outside; he is slow but big

theft.loot: the night's takings and whatever patrons leave lying about
theft.note: busy evenings are best; the bard and the drinkers are good cover, but Hulda counts her coin

theft.loot: the coin purse she keeps at her market stall
theft.note: the market is crowded at midday; she is sharp-tongued but turns her back to serve

theft.loot: the rings and coin he carries about the Cloud District
theft.note: he loves to be flattered and never looks at his own pockets

theft.loot: silver, jewellery and Imperial coin kept in the Battle-Born house
theft.note: rich pickings, but the house is full of Battle-Borns and their servants

flirt.loot: a few coins and a song or two
flirt.note: the bard thinks every woman is in love with him

flirt.loot: a generous purse from a well-off young man
flirt.note: unmarried, gentle, and lonely for company

flirt.loot: drinks and a handful of septims
flirt.note: an old soldier who drinks alone and talks to anyone who listens

flirt.loot: coin, or a trinket off his shelves as a present
flirt.note: he flirts with every woman who walks in

flirt.loot: a fat purse from a rich man who likes to be admired
flirt.note: rich, vain and married to Ahlam, who would not take it well

flirt.loot: small coin from bored guards on watch
flirt.note: they pay little, talk a lot, and may report a woman who pushes too hard

flirt.loot: coin from the till while his wife is at the forge
flirt.note: married to Adrianne, who is never far away
